hooks.name: Verify Build Safety
hooks.description: Reminds to check build safety, table sync, money gating, and actor integrity before writing source code

action.prompt: Before writing this file, verify: (1) The code must build with blank NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY. Auth and data helpers must degrade to null, never throw. (2) If adding a new table reference, confirm it exists in both supabase/schema.sql AND supabase/auth_setup.sql. (3) If touching money fields, confirm they are gated by canSeeMoney(role). (4) If writing created_by or activity_log, confirm it uses useEffectiveActor() not a raw id.
